name: The Word Was With God And The Word Was God
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound truth that the Word, existing from the beginning, was both with God and was God Himself, affirming the deity of Christ (John 1:1). This eternal Word became flesh and lived among humanity, displaying the unique glory of the Father's only Son, full of grace and truth (John 1:14). Jesus further confirms His divine identity by declaring His eternal existence before Abraham and His oneness with the Father (John 8:58; John 10:30), underscoring the unity and deity essential to a Christ-centered understanding of God.
